name: Summon Construct

source.note: Not in the free 2024 Basic Rules; written from knowledge of the 2024 PHB and cross-checked against aidedd.org's 2024 entry. Level, school, classes, casting time, range, components, duration and Concentration match the D&D Beyond 2024 spell list.

upcast.text: Use the slot's level as the spell's level in the Construct Spirit stat block.

summary: Summon a Construct Spirit (Clay, Metal or Stone) that fights beside you for up to 1 hour.
text: You call forth the spirit of a construct, which appears in an unoccupied space within range and uses the Construct Spirit stat block. When you cast the spell, choose Clay, Metal or Stone; the spirit takes a golem-like body of that material, and the choice sets some of its traits. It disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends. It is an ally of you and your allies. In combat it shares your Initiative count but takes its turn right after yours. It follows your verbal commands (no action required by you); if you give none, it takes the Dodge action and uses its movement to stay out of danger. Construct Spirit (Medium Construct): AC 13 + the spell's level; Hit Points 40 + 15 for each spell level above 4; Speed 30 ft.; Str 18, Dex 10, Con 18, Int 14, Wis 11, Cha 5; Resistance to Poison damage; can't be Charmed, Exhausted, Frightened, Paralyzed or Poisoned; Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 10; understands the languages you know; uses your Proficiency Bonus. Heated Body (Metal only): a creature that hits the spirit with a melee attack or grapples it takes 1d10 Fire damage. Stony Lethargy (Stone only): when a creature starts its turn within 10 feet of the spirit, the spirit can make it attempt a Wisdom save against your spell save DC; on a failure, until the start of its next turn its Speed is halved and it can't make Opportunity Attacks. Multiattack: it makes a number of Slam attacks equal to half the spell's level (round down). Slam: melee attack using your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft.; hit: 1d8 + 4 + the spell's level Bludgeoning damage. Berserk Lashing (Clay only, Reaction): when the spirit takes damage, it makes a Slam attack against a random creature within 5 feet of it; if none is in reach, it moves up to half its Speed toward an enemy it can see without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: use the slot's level as the spell's level in the stat block.
